## Request flow: `main` → store

1. **`cmd/svc/main.go`** — `main()` calls `config.Load()` (`config/config.go`) to read env vars, creates a `store.NewMemStore()` (`store/store.go`), then builds a `server.New(cfg, st, logger)` (`server/server.go`). Finally it calls `srv.HTTPServer().ListenAndServe()`, which wires up an `http.Server` with the configured address and timeouts.

2. **`server/server.go`** — `HTTPServer()` delegates to `Handler()`, which builds an `http.ServeMux` with Go 1.22 method+path patterns (`GET /items`, `POST /items`, `GET /items/{id}`, `DELETE /items/{id}`) and wraps it in the `logged` middleware (records method, path, status, duration).

3. **`server/handlers.go`** — The mux dispatches to the matching method on `Server` (`listItems`, `createItem`, `getItem`, `deleteItem`). Each handler decodes the request, calls the appropriate `store.Store` method, and maps sentinel errors (`ErrNotFound` → 404, `ErrExists` → 409) via `writeJSON`/`writeError`.

4. **`store/store.go`** — `MemStore` (a mutex-guarded `map[string]Item`) performs the actual read/write. Items are copied in/out so callers can't mutate stored state.

**Files involved:** `cmd/svc/main.go` → `config/config.go` → `server/server.go` → `server/handlers.go` → `store/store.go`.
